title: Distributed Tracing Across Real Service Calls
objective: Instrument one request that crosses at least two independently-running processes with OpenTelemetry tracing, and diagnose an induced slow span using the trace alone.
whyThisMatters: Logs and metrics tell you something is wrong; a trace tells you where, across process boundaries, without reading source code. This is the first task in the term where you must diagnose using telemetry alone rather than intuition.
evidence: A baseline trace export/screenshot with the trace id visible across both processes
Instrumentation code/config showing context propagation across the process boundary
A second trace export/screenshot captured after injecting a slow span
A written diagnosis note naming the slow span using only trace data
Reflection notes answering the task questions
acceptanceCriteria: The exported baseline trace shows a single trace id shared by spans from both processes.
The trace has a parent/child span structure reflecting the real call order.
The second trace's longest span corresponds to the component deliberately slowed down.
The diagnosis note identifies the slow span using only span names/durations, not source-code inspection.
